words.g: (possessive / linking particle) 's; of; (ends a description: 我的 mine, 红的 the red one)
or: a taxi; a cab (abbr. for 士)
words.n: Links a describer to a noun: what comes before 的 describes what comes after. With a pronoun it shows whose (我的 mine). Left at the end, it stands for the thing described (红的 the red one). Between close family or with familiar things it is often dropped: 我妈妈.

words.g: (particle) done, completed; (at the end) now, a change of state
words.n: Two jobs. After a verb it marks the action as done (吃了 ate). At the end of a sentence it marks a change: something is now so, or about to be. Not a past tense: habits in the past take no 了, and the negative 没 drops it.
ex: wǒ chī le liǎng wǎn fàn
I ate two bowls of rice.

words.g: to be (links two nouns); yes, right
words.n: Links two nouns: A 是 B. Adjectives don't take it (我很忙, not 我是忙). In 是…的 it picks out when, where or how something already happened.

words.g: at; in; on; to be (somewhere); (before a verb) in the middle of doing
words.n: Before a place: at, in (我在家). Before a verb: in the middle of doing (我在吃饭). After a verb it shows where something ends up (住在北京).

words.g: you (informal, as opposed to courteous 您)
to have; there is, there are

words.n: Negates the present, the future, habits and wishes, and adjectives. Before a fourth tone it changes to bú (不是 bú shì). For the past and for 有, use 没.

words.g: then; right away; just, only; exactly
words.n: Then, at once: shows something happens sooner, more easily, or exactly as said. 就是 means precisely, that's it.
ex: tā bā diǎn jiù dào le
He was already there by eight.

or: to compose a poem in reply (to someone's poem) using the same rhyme sequence; to join in the singing
to complete a set in mahjong or playing cards
to combine a powdery substance (flour, plaster etc) with water; Taiwan pr.
words.n: And, between nouns only; it doesn't join two sentences or two verbs.

words.g: to say; to speak; to talk
to want; will, going to; need to; must
words.n: To want; going to, will; need to, must. 不要 means don't.
The everyday measure word. Chinese puts a measure word between a number (or 这, 那, 几) and a noun. When unsure, 个 is the safe choice, though many nouns have their own.

or: to be fond of; to have a tendency to; to be prone to

words.n: One. Its tone shifts: yí before a fourth tone (一个 yí ge), yì before the others (一天 yì tiān), yī when counting or alone.
Also, too. Goes before the verb, never at the end of the sentence. With a negative: not ... either.

words.g: can (a learned skill); will, likely to; meeting
words.n: Can, from a learned skill (会游泳 can swim); will, likely to.
All, both: looks back at a plural before it. Goes before the verb. 都 + 了 can mean already.

words.g: right, correct; towards, to; (measure word for pairs)
up, above, on; last, previous; to go up, to get on
words.n: Up, on; last (上个月 last month); to go to, to attend (上班 go to work).

words.g: to arrive, to reach; to, until; (after a verb) achieved, got
to come; (after a verb) towards the speaker

words.n: Very, but before an adjective on its own it is often just the link a sentence needs: 我很好 is simply I'm fine.

words.g: still; also, in addition; even more; or (in questions: 还是)
words.n: Still; also, in addition; (in questions) 还是 means or.

or: to touch; to come in contact with
words.n: After a verb: an ongoing state rather than an action (sitting, wearing, the door standing open). Often with 呢 at the end.

words.g: to think; to want to, would like to; to miss (someone)
words.n: To want to, would like to (softer than 要); to think; to miss.
ex: I'd like to go to China.

words.n: Can: able to, or allowed to, in the circumstances.
To give; for, to someone (给你打电话 call you). After a verb, to (送给她 give to her).
ex: Give me a glass of water.

words.g: (particle) ah, oh; softens or stresses what is said
or: interjection expressing doubt or requiring answer; Eh?
interjection of surprise or doubt; Eh?

words.g: that; those; then, in that case
(marks the object before the verb: 把门关上 shut the door); to hold; (measure word for things with a handle)
words.n: Brings the object before the verb, to say what is done to it: 把 + thing + verb + result. The verb can't stand alone; it needs something after it (了, a place, a result).

words.g: to look at, to watch, to read; to visit; it depends; (after a verb) try and see
or: to look after; to take care of

words.n: Marks the passive: thing + 被 (+ doer) + verb. Usually for something unwelcome. In speech 让 and 叫 do the same.
ex: wǒ de chē bèi tōu le

for; because of; (wéi) as, to act as

words.n: May, can: permission, or it being possible.

words.g: (links a verb to how it is done: 跑得快 runs fast); (dé) to obtain; (děi) must
words.n: Between a verb and how it is done: 跑得快 runs fast. With an object, say the verb twice: 说中文说得很好. Read dé it means to get; read děi it means must.

or: bar (loanword) (serving drinks, or providing Internet access etc); to puff (on a pipe etc)
words.n: Softens a sentence into a suggestion (let's ...) or a guess wanting a yes (... right?).

words.g: to pass, to cross; to spend (time); (particle, guo) have done before
words.n: After a verb: have done (at least once) before, an experience. Negated with 没.

words.g: not (for the past, and with 有); not have
words.n: Negates what did or didn't happen, and 有 (没有 not have). It drops the 了 the positive would have.

words.g: (particle) turns a statement into a yes/no question
words.n: Turns a statement into a yes/no question. Don't add it when the sentence already asks (什么, 谁, 哪, A不A).

words.n: Only then, not until: the opposite of 就, things happening later or with more effort. Also only, just.
ex: He didn't get up until ten.

words.n: With, and (between nouns), and to follow. 跟…一样 means the same as.
